== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Who's Scruffy-Looking? (Japanese)|Who's Scruffy-Looking?]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/151452841/3RWAeeLHwkCn9IKEWJ-4_g.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 85187824.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>d3aff72748a4488763eeb7faa44ecb66b91f34a758150bc0c0b18ca5ab1f15b5</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
